title: Circular Economy for Strategic Management in the Copper Mining Industry
content: This study examines the awareness and adoption of Circular Economy (CE) principles within Chile's mining sector, the world's leading copper producer. Recognizing the potential disparity between public and private sector engagement, the study utilized surveys and interviews to assess perceptions and implementation levels of CE practices. Results indicated a stronger inclination towards CE within state-owned mining companies. In contrast, private companies, particularly small enterprises (1-100 employees), demonstrated limited engagement. Although employees generally expressed favorable views on CE, a significant gap exists between these perceptions and the implementation of concrete corporate initiatives. This discrepancy is largely attributed to the absence of dedicated CE units. The study concludes by recommending targeted strategies to facil-itate CE adoption for small and medium enterprises (SMEs), particularly those in mining ser-vices, to foster sustainable practices within the industry.
